CustomField.description: CIBGLOBALD-3779: Editable term, in whole months, for Risk Approval lines (OtherProducts / Sanction record types). Editing this field in the dmt_lineInfo LWC recalculates End_Date__c from Start_Date__c (Start Date stays fixed). Blank on record creation. Unrelated to the pre-existing read-only Line_Term__c formula field, which is left untouched.
CustomField.label: Risk Approval Term
